GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Near the 50m laid out and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled back last rails 6 Lengths 600m, stayed there, brow band first time, winkers off first time # always last
Slow Out 1 Lengths , overraced back 2nd last rails 8 Lengths 800m, did nothing in Straight # never close
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped another runner. Jockey reported that his mount was inclined to lay out throughout the event, particularly throughout the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Pushed to recover & raced behind Mid Field on inside (5L from lead). Stayed same until hung out badly & back 2 Lengths @ 600m & lost touch with bunch @ 500m. Gave ground from home turn. winkers first time. # Beaten @ 500m.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start, was buffeted between runners. Rider reported that entering the corner near the 700m, her mount commenced to hang out, before losing ground and running wider on the track when she momentarily lost full use of her right rein. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Trainer was advised that a warning would be recorded against the gelding.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Debut for stable. Slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (7L from lead). Stayed @ rear on inside midrace & pushed to quicken @ 450m. Chasing Two Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & made slight ground in last 200m. # Fair 1st-up run.
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 lengths, under pressure turn 3 lengths. weakened # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When quest rdr stated he intended to lead however, despite heavy riding, mount failed to muster speed & settled in handy posn. Rdr stated mount travelled only fairly in middle stages & was under full pressure app h/turn. Rdr stated mount failed to sprint on straightening & was very disapp to line. Rdr added mount was agitated prior to event & overall gave him the impression it was not interest in racing. Tnr advised to transfer gelding from stable.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Niggled early & raced 6th 3 Wide With Cover (2.5L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & pushed to hold ground @ 500m. Pushed out along Seven Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground Seven Wide until eased down in last 150m. # Wide & tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Awkward and slow to begin thereafter shifted out and bumped a runner. Near the 1100m had to be checked to avoid the heels of a runner which shifted in when insufficiently clear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Hampered @ start. Pushed fwd to lead on inside by 2 Lengths early . Held 1 length lead on inside midrace & niggled to quicken Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & fought on well in last 150m. Held on late. Gelded. # Led - held on.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping away was hampered when tightened between runners, which both shifted ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly . Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (6L from lead). Held Ground until improving 2 @ 400m. Pushed along & laid out Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & chased well in last 200m. # Solid from rear.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Rounding the home turn laid outwards and bumped. Thereafter continued to lay outwards in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Niggled to recover & worked to lead on rail by 1/2L early . Held lead on inside midrace & joined @ 400m. Pushed along with natrrow lead Two Wide on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & weakened in last 150m # Led & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was inclined to lay out under pressure over the final 200m.
